title: Investigate elevated payment authorization failures
content: Check recent deployments and configuration changes. Compare service error rate and latency against baseline. Inspect provider authorization latency and timeout rate. Check database connection utilization, query latency, and errors. Inspect distributed traces to identify the slow or failing segment. Compare behavior across application versions when safe. Do not assume temporal proximity proves causation. If a critical observability source is unavailable, record reduced evidence coverage and require additional human verification before consequential remediation.
